summary: Built src/rvt/encode.py, the schema-directed encoder that is the exact structural inverse of objects.py's decoder (Writer mirrors Reader; parent-first field walk; same breadth-first deferred-body FIFO; original pid numbering rides the value tree so it reproduces for free), plus record framing (i64 id [+u32 stamp seq 102/103] + u32 psize + u16 class_id + object + u32 psize repeat, incl. id=-1 sentinels and SerializedDummy). Byte-exact decode->encode round trip is 100.000% over the ENTIRE decodable corpus: 1,153,554 records across racbasic/rmebasic/racadvanced/rstadvanced/rstbasic x seq 101/102/103, 397 distinct classes, 0 failures; and whole-segment reconstruction is byte-identical for every project x seq (rstbasic Partitions/21 seq 101/102/103 included). Achieving this required two minimal decoder fixes for latent information loss: (1) shadowed field names (18 classes re-declare an ancestor field, e.g. PropertySetLibrary.m_locked vs Element.m_locked) collided in the flat dict — fixed with objects.field_key(), first occurrence keeps plain name, shadow keyed 'Class::name', same rule in encoder; (2) AString decode errors='replace' -> 'surrogatepass' so lone surrogates round-trip. ES-entity records (1,178, undecodable per B1) pass through opaque as briefed.
key_findings: Corpus round trip is 100.000% byte-exact: 1,153,554 tested records (every cleanly-decodable record + all id=-1 sentinels) across 5 projects x seq 101/102/103, 397 distinct record classes, 0 failures — target was >=99%. racbasic seq102 85,978/85,978 (306 classes); rmebasic seq102 141,309/141,309 (306 classes); racadvanced 59,575/59,575 (312); rstadvanced 65,147/65,147 (300); rstbasic 32,057/32,057 (310); seq 101/103 100% in every file.

Whole-segment reconstruction is byte-identical for all 15 project x seq segments (e.g. rstbasic Partitions/21: seq101 5,888,965 B, seq102 25,524,205 B, seq103 8,400,602 B; racbasic seq102 63,944,890 B; rmebasic seq102 111,373,476 B).

The pointer/pid model needs NO re-derivation for reversibility: the decoder preserves every pid it read and encodes token kind structurally (ptr_class/backref_pid/weakref/None), so re-walking in schema order + a FIFO appended at the same moments reproduces the ORIGINAL pid numbering and breadth-first deferred body order — 100+-object FamilySymbol trees round-trip first try.

DECODER BUG FOUND & FIXED: 18 of 4,690 classes re-declare an ancestor's field name (PropertySetLibrary.m_locked, RbsFlexPipeType.m_dRoughness, m_pConnectorManager across the RbsInsulation family, EnergyAnalysisSurface.m_id, MasterImportSymbol maps, PanelScheduleView.m_oTableData...). The flat value dict silently dropped the earlier value. objects.field_key() now keys the shadow as 'DeclaringClass::name' (first occurrence keeps its plain name; consumers unaffected). This was the only source of round-trip mismatch in real data.

DECODER FIX 2: Reader.astring used errors='replace' — lone UTF-16 surrogates decoded to U+FFFD and could not round-trip; changed to surrogatepass on both sides (no corpus string was affected; needed for a true inverse).

Confirmed NOT lossy (no handling needed): all bools are wire 0/1, no NaN payloads in float/double, -0.0 and denormals bit-exact via struct, no ambiguous zero-length containers or null-vs-empty strings, f32->f64->f32 exact for all corpus values.

Only the u32 record stamp (seq 102/103) cannot be synthesized for a brand-new record — encoder passes the source value through; its generation rule (and whether Revit validates it) is the remaining unknown for from-scratch record creation.

open_questions: u32 record stamp (seq 102/103): passed through from the source record; Revit's generation rule and whether the loader validates it are unknown — matters only when synthesizing brand-new records.
New-object pid allocation policy: reproducing existing pids is exact, but which sub-objects a from-scratch element should index (pid>2) vs mark anonymous (-1) is unstudied.
Extensible-Storage entity records (1,178 = 0.1% of corpus) cannot be field-wise re-encoded (blocker B1) — currently opaque pass-through only.
dach-sample-project (128 MB partition) not exercised (runtime only).
next_steps: Wire encode_record + reencode_segment into writer.py's block re-framer (regzip/re-frame helpers) so an edited object can be spliced into a Partitions/N stream once rvt.ecc.page_trailer() lands.
Acceptance test the stamp: rewrite one record with stamp 0 / stamp+1 and open in the Autodesk viewer to learn whether it is validated.
Add a validate_value() pass with friendly errors so hand-authored object dicts (not decoder output) can be checked against the schema before encoding.
Study/implement an assign_pids() normalizer for from-scratch elements after confirming loader tolerance for -1 vs indexed pids.
Orchestrator: consider a shared segment cache (RVT_SEG_CACHE default) — partition inflation dominates every partition-consuming agent's runtime (see docs/inbox/serializer.md).
